sar.narrative: On 2016-11-21, card C07297-K1 held under customer C07297 was used for 4 transaction(s) totalling $1,906.07 that this investigation attributes to a single episode of undocumented coordinated abuse. The transactions are 3476602, 3476633, 3476665, 3476682, and the first suspicious one is 3476602. They were online transactions under product code(s) C, billed in region code 264.0. How it was carried out: 4 online purchases of $400 to $500 on this card inside 60 minutes, totalling $1,906.07, each amount stopping just short of a round authorization ceiling. The activity departs from the card's own history: amount at the 96% percentile. The cardholder, asked to validate the activity, was assumed to deny it (simulated response). The bank's detection model scored the flagged transaction 0.25; that score prompted the review and was not relied on as a finding. It is reported because Policy 3a: exposure $1,906.07 exceeds $1,000; the pattern is coordinated or undocumented, rule R9. Actions recommended: BLOCK_CARD, CREATE_CASE, FILE_REPORT, ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST.
